headline: ElevenLabs free tier lacks commercial rights for game dialogue, Starter plan required for monetized titles
summary: While ElevenLabs offers impressive voice quality for NPCs, its free tier explicitly prohibits commercial use in monetized games, requiring developers to upgrade to a paid plan.
details: ElevenLabs now delivers high-quality, realistic NPC dialogue and narration, often indistinguishable from real recordings. However, the free tier comes with a critical licensing restriction: it grants no commercial rights, meaning any audio generated cannot be used in monetized games without attribution.
The Starter plan, priced at $5/month, is the actual entry point for commercially shippable audio. Developers should be aware of this limitation before generating any lines for their projects.

Voice Design generates synthetic voices from text descriptions and is more stable than instant cloning, which requires 1-3 minutes of clean audio. Instant cloning can drift on longer or unusual sentences, a crucial factor for main characters with extensive dialogue.

A recurring challenge is the inconsistent pronunciation of fantasy names. Phonetic spelling in the input text, like 'Zrathool' for 'Xrathul', helps the model achieve consistent results. The technology currently struggles with screaming, extreme emotional delivery, and singing, which often sound strained or artificial.
caption:
Don't get caught by ElevenLabs' free tier trap for game dialogue. Commercial use requires a paid plan, starting at $5/month.

However, the free tier comes with a critical licensing restriction: it grants no commercial rights, meaning any audio generated cannot be used in monetized games without attribution.

The Starter plan, priced at $5/month, is the actual entry point for commercially shippable audio. Developers should be aware of this limitation before generating any lines for their projects.

Voice Design generates synthetic voices from text descriptions and is more stable than instant cloning, which requires 1-3 minutes of clean audio. Instant cloning can drift on longer or unusual sentences, a crucial factor for main characters with extensive dialogue.

A recurring challenge is the inconsistent pronunciation of fantasy names. Phonetic spelling in the input text, like 'Zrathool' for 'Xrathul', helps the model achieve consistent results. The technology currently struggles with screaming, extreme emotional delivery, and singing, which often sound strained or artificial.

headline_marked: [[Audi launches 2027 Q9 flagship SUV]] for the US market, starting at $87,700
headline: Audi launches 2027 Q9 flagship SUV for the US market, starting at $87,700
summary: Audi's new full-size 2027 Q9 SUV, designed specifically for the US market, debuts as the brand's new flagship. It offers a larger third row and advanced tech, with sales starting in Q4.
details: Audi has officially unveiled the 2027 Q9, its new full-size flagship SUV, specifically designed for the US market. Starting at $87,700, the Q9 will go on sale in Q4, becoming the brand's top-tier vehicle.

Measuring 209 inches long with a 123.5-inch wheelbase, the Q9 is significantly larger than the Q7, providing ample room, especially for the third row. While substantial, it appears less imposing than rivals like the Mercedes-Benz GLS or BMW X7.
The exterior design features more curves and subtle creases compared to older Audi models, giving it a distinct look. Its large wheels contribute to a unique visual presence.

Built on the Volkswagen Group's new Premium Platform Combustion (PPC) architecture, the Q9 launches with a 2.9L V6 engine. A performance-oriented SQ9 model will also be available, featuring a twin-turbo V8 and rear-biased all-wheel drive.

The Q9 brings Audi's active-matrix LED headlights to the US, capable of selectively dimming portions of the beam to prevent glare and project driving aids. New turn signals also project indicators onto the roadway for enhanced visibility for other road users.

Inside, the Q9 offers a massive panoramic roof with electrochromic dimming and flexible seating for six or seven passengers. Cargo capacity ranges from 19.3 cubic feet with all seats up to 87.7 cubic feet with all seats folded, and it boasts a 7,700 lbs towing capacity.
